model.title: Snow Water Supply Forecasting Program Reauthorization Act of 2025
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. John Hickenlooper (D-CO)

summary.text: The bill would reauthorize the federal Snow Water Supply Forecasting Program, which helps predict water availability from snowpack for planning and water management purposes. It aims to continue funding and support for this program that assists water managers, farmers, and communities in the western United States prepare for seasonal water supplies.
